I replied to Ilse in her #north-random thread. I told her I'd noted that the next renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co. is 10 June and that nothing else was changed. I also suggested she fix the earlier date she posted in #north-team, since people there could still act on it.

She said no action was needed, so I didn't post in #north-team, didn't read it and didn't change anything else. A renewal date isn't a finance figure, so it was fine to repeat it in the channel without approval.
